brief:
The Popular Committee of Aida Refugee Camp participated in the annual Humanity Festival in France from Sept. 10-13, 2026, Palestine News Network reported. The committee attended at the invitation of L'Humanité, a French newspaper affiliated with the French Communist Party.

The festival appearance gave the camp's representatives a platform to highlight Palestinian refugee conditions and concerns before an international audience.

title: Aida Camp committee addresses refugee issues at French festival
